description: This file defines a React hook 'useItemHeights' that calculates and provides various height and indentation metrics for items in a folder tree UI component, based on the current theme. It includes constants for different item heights, separators, and indentation widths, and uses theme tokens for dynamic calculations.

methods.name: calculateItemHeights
methods.description: Calculates item heights and indentation metrics based on the provided theme, including heights for regular items, folder headers, separators, and empty folders.

methods.name: useItemHeights
methods.description: React hook that retrieves the current theme and returns calculated item heights and indentation metrics for use in virtualized list rendering.
